Read an operational ratings export

Source: R/read_operational_ratings.R
read_operational_ratings.Rd

Reads an export of operational power-law ratings, one row per limb, into a table with the package's own names. Each row's equation is Q = C (H - A)^B: the export's A becomes a (the stage of zero flow), B becomes n (the exponent) and C stays C. Nothing is reinterpreted. As with read_gaugings(), everything is read as text, parsed explicitly, and anything that did not parse is noted on its row in read_issue and not dropped.

Ratings flagged as grid-to-grid model output (G2G is TRUE) are omitted by default, because they are model estimates and not operational ratings; the message says how many rows went. Set omit_g2g = FALSE to keep them and filter on the g2g column. The export's Flag is carried through as flag with no meaning assumed.

The export marks an open-ended top limb with an upper level of 999; open_ended is TRUE for those rows and the level itself is left as it is.

Usage

read_operational_ratings(
  x,
  rating_id = "ID",
  station_id = "FFFSLocID",
  station_name = "FFFSLocName",
  qualifier = "Qualifier",
  season = "Season",
  start_date = "StartDate",
  end_date = "EndDate",
  curve_id = "RatingCurveID",
  source_id = "SourceID",
  lower_level = "LowerLevel",
  upper_level = "UpperLevel",
  offset = "A",
  exponent = "B",
  scale = "C",
  flag = "Flag",
  ea = "EA",
  g2g = "G2G",
  omit_g2g = TRUE,
  open_ended_level = 999,
  date_format = NULL,
  quiet = FALSE
)

Arguments

x

A file path to a delimited text file, or a data.frame.

rating_id, station_id, station_name, qualifier, season, curve_id, source_id, flag, ea, g2g

Character. Names of the export's columns. The defaults match the export (ID, FFFSLocID, FFFSLocName, Qualifier, Season, RatingCurveID, SourceID, Flag, EA, G2G). A column that is absent under its default name is simply skipped; one you name yourself must exist. NULL skips a column.

start_date, end_date

Character. Columns holding the dates the rating applies from and to.

lower_level, upper_level

Character. Columns holding each limb's stage range (m).

offset, exponent, scale

Character. Columns holding A, B and C. Defaults "A", "B", "C".

omit_g2g

Logical. Drop rows where g2g is TRUE. Default TRUE.

open_ended_level

Numeric. An upper level at or above this marks an open-ended limb. Default 999.

date_format

A strptime() format for both date columns, or NULL (default) to detect each column's format.

quiet

Logical. TRUE suppresses the summary message.

Value

A data.table, one row per limb, with source_row, rating_key (the rating id and the curve id together, which identifies one rating), rating_id, station_id, station_name, qualifier, season, start_date, end_date, end_before_start (TRUE where the end date is earlier than the start date, which in this export is how an open end appears; left for you to interpret), curve_id, source_id, lower_level, upper_level, open_ended, C, a, n, flag, ea, g2g and read_issue.

Notes the function can add

station id missing, lower level missing, upper level missing, A missing, B missing, C missing, a value not a number (for any of those columns), upper level not above lower level, C not positive, B not positive, G2G not read, and date not read.

See also

operational_rating_tables() to turn the limbs into rating tables; read_gaugings().

Examples

raw <- data.frame(
  ID = rep(c("r1", "r2"), c(3, 2)), FFFSLocID = rep(c("4761", "29004"), c(3, 2)),
  FFFSLocName = rep(c("Spinney Hill Park", "Ancholme Bishopbridge"), c(3, 2)),
  Qualifier = "Power", Season = "All",
  StartDate = "01/01/2000 00:00", EndDate = "12/31/1999 12:00:00 AM",
  RatingCurveID = rep(c("c1", "c2"), c(3, 2)), SourceID = "s1",
  LowerLevel = c(0, 0.241, 0.897, 0, 0.314), UpperLevel = c(0.241, 0.897, 999, 0.314, 999),
  A = c(0, 0.1, 0.4, 0, 0.01), B = c(1.254, 1.541, 0.8265, 1.5042, 2.2279),
  C = c(3.114, 10.717, 13.462, 4.711, 11.7052),
  Flag = c(0, 0, 3, 0, 0), EA = TRUE, G2G = c(FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, TRUE)
)
limbs <- read_operational_ratings(raw)
#> read_operational_ratings(): 3 limbs in 1 ratings at 1 stations.
#>   G2G rows omitted: 2. Rows with a note: 0. Most common: none.
limbs[, c("rating_key", "station_id", "lower_level", "upper_level", "C", "a", "n", "open_ended")]
#>    rating_key station_id lower_level upper_level      C     a      n open_ended
#>        <char>     <char>       <num>       <num>  <num> <num>  <num>     <lgcl>
#> 1:      r1/c1       4761       0.000       0.241  3.114   0.0 1.2540      FALSE
#> 2:      r1/c1       4761       0.241       0.897 10.717   0.1 1.5410      FALSE
#> 3:      r1/c1       4761       0.897     999.000 13.462   0.4 0.8265       TRUE
